name: Old Ninth, the Deep Foreman
place: dungeon mine_descent: the boss cavern of the last floor (28 m square)
_doc: Stream E. A stone-and-iron overseer built to keep the ninth shift working; it never stopped. P1 'Shift Start': pick swings for the tank, ore tossed at random players (each lump stays as cover), three drill lines, and a Shift Whistle you hide from behind the four timber props. P2 at 60% 'Blasting': it locks down in an iron shell and the shift rats pour in; light the three blasting fuses to crack the shell (it tries to stamp them out — interrupt it). P3 is a new health bar 'Overtime': the cracked floor caves into pits, the props must be HELD (stand on the soak circles at each standing prop or the roof falls on everyone), a three-player stack, a grinding spiral. Hard enrage at 5.5 minutes. The winch lever drops the ore bucket on it once.
party: Solo: hold-the-props soaks (one per standing prop) cannot be covered — survivable fails only. 2-3: playable, some fails. 5: intended. M5 scaling: soaks = min(standing props, party); shift bell stack need = min(3, party); shift rats by party.

onUse.say: The ore bucket drops — straight onto Old Ninth!

pull: NEW HANDS. GOOD. THE SEAM DOES NOT DIG ITSELF.
say.death: Old Ninth grinds to a halt. Somewhere deep inside it, a bell rings once for the end of the shift.
say.reset: OLD NINTH RETURNS TO THE FACE. QUOTA UNMET.

enrage.say: QUOTA FAILED. ALL HANDS WILL BE BURIED.

ore_toss.name: Ore Toss
ore_toss.say: Old Ninth hurls lumps of ore!

whistle.name: Shift Whistle
whistle.say: THE WHISTLE BLOWS. — Get behind a prop or an ore lump!

stamp_fuses.name: Stamp Out
stamp_fuses.say: NO BLASTING ON MY SHIFT. — It is stamping out the fuses, stop it!

actions.say: The fuses are out. Light them again!

hold_props.name: Hold the Props
hold_props.say: The roof groans — someone hold every prop that still stands!

telegraphs.failSay: A prop slips — rock rains down on everyone!

shift_bell.name: Shift Bell
shift_bell.say: {target} is ringing the bell — share the load, three of you!

grinding_wheel.name: Grinding Wheel
grinding_wheel.say: Old Ninth spins up its grinding wheel!

phases.name: Blasting
phases.say: BLASTING IN PROGRESS. CLEAR THE FACE.

onEnter.say: Old Ninth locks into an iron shell. Light all three blasting fuses!

phases.name: Overtime
phases.say: OVERTIME. NOBODY LEAVES UNTIL THE SEAM IS CLEARED.

do.say: BOOM! The charges crack Old Ninth's shell wide open!
Every prop is down. Only the ore lumps are left to hide behind!
